# UI extensions

Django UI extensions (XUI). Each folder has a README.

| Extension | ID | Description |
|---|---|---|
| AWS EKS Cluster | [XUI-8a1jocmr](XUI-8a1jocmr/README.md) | Adds Cluster, Node groups, and Workloads tabs to AWS EKS cluster resources with live cluster and add-on status, a Kubernetes upgrade banner, node group scaling and deletion, and per-node and per-namespace workload figures, and Connect and Workloads tabs to Kubernetes namespace landing zones with kubectl access details and a live inventory. |
| Azure NSG Management | [XUI-0jdk7t6h](XUI-0jdk7t6h/README.md) | Adds a Security Rules tab to Azure network security group resources for viewing and editing inbound and outbound rules. |
| Azure Patches | [XUI-6nzs882l](XUI-6nzs882l/README.md) | Adds a Patching server tab to Azure VMs that shows the latest patch assessment and runs scan and apply jobs. |
| Content Package Manager | [XUI-iq65xgvr](XUI-iq65xgvr/README.md) | Adds a Content Packages admin page for defining named sets of blueprints, actions, plugins, shared modules, and UI extensions, and for exporting, syncing, or importing each set through CloudBolt's own per-object repository push and sync. |
| HCP Terraform Workspace | [XUI-ax1sluwi](XUI-ax1sluwi/README.md) | Adds Terraform and Terraform Variables tabs to HCP Terraform resources with the workspace summary, no-code module name and version with an update-available notice, drift and cost estimate, run history with CloudBolt job links, a pending-run discard, managed resources, and read-only variables. |
| Io Cloudbolt Prometheus | [XUI-60382c9x](XUI-60382c9x/README.md) | Adds a Prometheus-backed Monitoring server tab and a service-discovery endpoint that lists servers tagged monitor. |
| Io Cloudbolt Widgets | [XUI-ycumvq8k](XUI-ycumvq8k/README.md) | Adds nine dashboard widgets covering server counts, cloud availability, and other operational summaries. |
| Openscap | [XUI-i4kzuy3y](XUI-i4kzuy3y/README.md) | Adds an OpenSCAP server tab for Enterprise Linux servers that runs profile scans and collects the HTML reports. |
| Ssm Inventory | [XUI-l43ailkn](XUI-l43ailkn/README.md) | Adds Inventory and Patching server tabs for EC2 instances managed by AWS Systems Manager. |
| Technology Reference | [XUI-vwrd15py](XUI-vwrd15py/README.md) | Adds a read-only Technology Reference tab to Resource Handler and Environment pages listing the technology's custom fields, actions, and field dependencies, discovered live from the instance and exportable as one .xlsx. |
